name: Jeuz
overview: Jeuz is a male figure from the tribe of Benjamin, uniquely identified as the son of Shaharaim. The biblical record concerning Jeuz is limited, with no additional personal notes or detailed background provided beyond his lineage. His mention is brief and specific, anchoring him within the genealogical context of Benjamin.
namesAndTitles: The name Jeuz is a proper name that means 'he comes to help' or possibly 'encouraged.' This meaning reflects a sense of assistance or support, though the name was not given directly by God. The significance of the name is preserved in the genealogical listing where it appears.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Jeuz as the son of Shaharaim and also mentions Hodesh as a son of Shaharaim, indicating Jeuz's place within this family line. Beyond these relationships, no further family connections or descendants are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jeuz's importance lies primarily in his role within the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, serving as a link in the ancestral line. His mention in 1 Chronicles 8:10 situates him within the historical and tribal framework that contributes to understanding the heritage of Benjamin. While the biblical narrative does not elaborate on his deeds or character, his inclusion underscores the careful preservation of Israel's tribal genealogies.
